title: Green valorisation of biowastes – electrochemical “one-pot” reductive amination of furfural on a graphite electrode in water
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00335K, Communication
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Joel Donkeng-Dazie, Lucie Koláčná, Martin Lamač, Jiří Ludvík
A new “green” way of reductive amination of furfural (from lignocellulosic biowastes) is presented, using electrochemistry, where in situ formed imines are directly reduced on a carbon electrode in basic media to furyl-substituted vicinal diamines.
